package.name: so101_safety
package.description: SO-101 safety subsystem: shared enforcement nodes for the protective-stop contract (trajectory_safety_gate for the JointTrajectory/JTC path, safety_pause_bridge for the MoveIt Servo path). Pure C++, no perception or ML/vision dependencies -- both nodes just subscribe to /safety/protective_stop (std_msgs/Bool). For the ai-vision-ros2 single snap demo, the perception-driven trigger logic (ROI/thresholds/hysteresis) lives directly in each AI snap's own node (so101_depth_demo's depth_anything_node, so101_yolo_demo's yolo_detect_node), which publish that topic directly -- so swapping the AI backend via `snap refresh --channel=...` swaps the entire behaviour, including what counts as a protective stop, without needing any change here. Intended as the home for future safety behaviours (diagnostics, watchdogs, ...).
